fields.label: Score Balls Outside Zone
fields.help: If true, objectives will count for their capture zone's team even when not inside that zone. This is also known as "paintball" mode as balls conceptually are "painted" by their capture zone until captured by a different one. This means that objectives will not return to "neutral" when removed from a capture zone.
